about: PIN-80 nutrition eval. Each reference is per serving, worked out by hand from USDA FoodData Central values for the listed amounts (Claude, 2026-11-22; review before trusting the numbers). Pinch estimates from the recipe text, so the tolerance is wide: calories within 25%, each macro within 30% or 6 g, whichever is looser.

cases.title: Overnight oats
steps: Stir everything together in a jar.

cases.title: Chicken and broccoli rice bowl
steps: Fry the chicken in the oil until cooked through.
Steam the broccoli and serve everything over the rice.

cases.title: Red lentil soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrots in the oil.
Add the lentils, cumin and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.

cases.title: Chocolate chip cookies
steps: Beat in the eggs, then the flour and baking soda.
Fold in the chips and bake 24 cookies at 180°C for 11 minutes.

cases.title: שקשוקה
steps: שוברים את הביצים לתוך הרוטב ומבשלים עד שהחלבון מתייצב.
